name: riptide
description: A desktop BitTorrent client on the Undercurrent engine, built with Electrobun.

scripts.dev: bun run engine && bun run view && electrobun dev
scripts.dev:watch: bun run engine && bun run view && electrobun dev --watch
scripts.dev:hmr: bun run engine && bun run view && (vite --port 5183 --strictPort & VITE=$!; trap 'kill $VITE' EXIT; electrobun dev)
scripts.build: bun run engine && bun run view && electrobun build --env=stable
scripts.test: bun run test:engine && bun run test:bun && bun run test:ui
